name: baidu_marketing-mcp
display_name: 百度营销 Baidu Marketing MCP
description: 百度营销 Baidu Marketing (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report, update_budget, pause_resu

platform_mcp_baidu_marketing_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BAIDU_MARKETING_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_baidu_marketing_client_id.description: Your application's appId (商业开发者中心 → 应用管理 → 应用详情).

platform_mcp_baidu_marketing_client_secr.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BAIDU_MARKETING_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_baidu_marketing_client_secr.description: The application's secretKey (shown in the approved application's details).

platform_mcp_baidu_marketing_refresh_tok.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BAIDU_MARKETING_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_baidu_marketing_refresh_tok.description: refreshToken from exchanging the authorization code once at POST https://u.baidu.com/oauth/accessToken (valid 30 days; each refresh returns a new one, saved when PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR is set).

platform_mcp_baidu_marketing_user_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BAIDU_MARKETING_USER_ID
platform_mcp_baidu_marketing_user_id.description: userId of the promotion account that authorized the app (returned by the OAuth callback / accessToken exchange).

platform_mcp_baidu_marketing_user_name.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BAIDU_MARKETING_USER_NAME
platform_mcp_baidu_marketing_user_name.description: 推广账户名称 (userName) of the account to operate — sent as header.userName; with a super-admin (超管) authorization this may be any sub-account.

tools.name: me
tools.description: AccountService/getAccountInfo with header {userName, accessToken}: account id, balance, budget and status (userStat 2 = active).

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: MccFeedService/getUserListByMccid: the sub-accounts of an account manager (账户管家) authorization — 'this interface is only for account-manager permission'. A single-account authorization has only the user_name account (see me). The id is userid; pass the username as account_id.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: CampaignService/getCampaign without campaignIds ('输入空返回整个账户的计划'): every search campaign of the account. `account_id` is the 推广账户名称 (userName) sent in the header. budget is the daily budget in CNY (null = unlimited); pause true = paused. `status` and paging are not applied.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: OpenApiReportService/getReportData, 计划报告 (reportType 2290316) per DAY: impressions, clicks, cost (CNY), ctr, cpc and conversions per campaign; values are strings. `account_id` is the userName sent in the header. `campaign_id` is not applied — filter the rows by campaign_id (the report's campaignId column). Max range 731 days; up to 10,000 rows.

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: CampaignService/updateCampaign {campaignTypes: [{campaignId, budget}]}: the campaign's daily budget in CNY, range [50, min(10,000,000, account budget)]. `currency` is not applied (CNY). A refused update answers with no campaign record (the reason is in header.failures).

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: CampaignService/updateCampaign {campaignTypes: [{campaignId, pause}]}: pause true = 暂停, false = 启用.
